sources.title: AICD Bench: A Challenging Benchmark for AI-Generated Code Detection
sources.use: Hold-out family, domain and hybrid-label evaluation requirements.
sources.implementation: Protocol implemented; original benchmark not downloaded or reproduced.

sources.title: UCSC-NLP at SemEval-2026 Task 13: Multi-View Generalization and Diagnostic Analysis of Machine-Generated Code Detection
sources.use: Separate raw and normalized/structural code views; quantify distribution shift.
sources.implementation: Handcrafted multi-view baseline only; no UniXcoder fine-tuning or paper reproduction.

sources.title: CodeMirage: A Multi-Lingual Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated and Paraphrased Source Code from Production-Level LLMs
sources.use: Include rewritten, unfamiliar-generator and language-shift conditions.
sources.implementation: Evaluation design reference; multilingual detector/data collection remain unqualified.

sources.title: Spotting LLMs With Binoculars: Zero-Shot Detection of Machine-Generated Text
sources.use: Two-reference-model contrastive likelihood rather than free-text authorship judgments.
sources.implementation: Local-only adapter and tested numerical kernel; real model weights and code-specific operating threshold unqualified.

sources.title: DualCodeDetect: Zero-Shot LLM-Generated Code Detection via Dual-Channel Perturbation
sources.implementation: Researched, not implemented. No heuristic transform is falsely certified semantics-preserving.

sources.title: MATRIX: Multi-Layer Code Watermarking via Dual-Channel Constrained Parity-Check Encoding
sources.use: Optional explicit provenance for deliberately marked outputs.
sources.implementation: Researched only; not a detector for arbitrary unmarked provider outputs.

sources.title: Multi-Channel Spread-Spectrum Code Watermarking
sources.use: Robustness and coverage considerations for an optional watermark adapter.
sources.implementation: Researched only; no embedded watermark decoder or universal fingerprint claimed.

sources.title: MultiAIGCD: a comprehensive dataset for AI generated code detection covering multiple languages, models, prompts, and scenarios
sources.use: Consider multiple prompting and editing scenarios rather than only clean generation.
sources.implementation: Dataset shortlist; license and provenance admission still required.
